title: Cooling and Freezing Equipment Operators and Tenders
description: Operate or tend equipment such as cooling and freezing units, refrigerators, batch freezers, and freezing tunnels, to cool or freeze products, food, blood plasma, and chemicals.

projection.title: Cooling and freezing equipment operators and tenders

tasks.text: Record temperatures, amounts of materials processed, or test results on report forms.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Monitor pressure gauges, ammeters, flowmeters, thermometers, or products, and adjust controls to maintain specified conditions, such as feed rate, product consistency, temperature, air pressure, and machine speed.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Instrument monitoring needs physical sensor presence

dwas.name: Monitor instruments to ensure proper production conditions.

tasks.text: Read dials and gauges on panel control boards to ascertain temperatures, alkalinities, and densities of mixtures, and turn valves to obtain specified mixtures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.
Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.

tasks.text: Start machinery, such as pumps, feeders, or conveyors, and turn valves to heat, admit, or transfer products, refrigerants, or mixes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.
Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.
Operate pumping systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Correct machinery malfunctions by performing actions such as removing jams, and inform supervisors of malfunctions as necessary.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Notifying maintenance needs is routine messaging

dwas.name: Clear equipment jams.
Notify others of equipment repair or maintenance needs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Assemble equipment, and attach pipes, fittings, or valves, using hand tools.

dwas.name: Assemble electromechanical or hydraulic systems.
Install mechanical components in production equipment.

tasks.text: Measure or weigh specified amounts of ingredients or materials, and load them into tanks, vats, hoppers, or other equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measuring and dispensing of ingredients

dwas.name: Measure ingredients or substances to be used in production processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.

tasks.text: Adjust machine or freezer speed and air intake to obtain desired consistency and amount of product.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Weigh packages and adjust freezer air valves or switches on filler heads to obtain specified amounts of product in each container.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically weighing finished products on scale

dwas.name: Weigh finished products.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.

tasks.text: Inspect and flush lines with solutions or steam, and spray equipment with sterilizing solutions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual sterilization of cooking equipment

dwas.name: Sterilize food cooking or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Load and position wrapping paper, sticks, bags, or cartons into dispensing machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of materials into equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.

tasks.text: Sample and test product characteristics such as specific gravity, acidity, and sugar content, using hydrometers, pH meters, or refractometers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical/physical testing requires lab manipulation

dwas.name: Test chemical or physical characteristics of materials or products.
Collect samples of materials or products for testing.

tasks.text: Start agitators to blend contents, or start beater, scraper, and expeller blades to mix contents with air and prevent sticking.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on operation of mixing machinery

dwas.name: Operate mixing equipment.

tasks.text: Insert forming fixtures, and start machines that cut frozen products into measured portions or specified shapes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Place or position containers into equipment, and remove containers after completion of cooling or freezing processes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical placement of containers for material flow

dwas.name: Position containers to receive materials or workpieces.

tasks.text: Scrape, dislodge, or break excess frost, ice, or frozen product from equipment to prevent accumulation, using hands and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of equipment in unstructured settings

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.

tasks.text: Activate mechanical rakes to regulate flow of ice from storage bins to vats.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical valve/control manipulation for coolant

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate coolant flow.

tasks.text: Stir material with spoons or paddles to mix ingredients or allow even cooling and prevent coagulation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical mixing of chemical solutions

dwas.name: Mix substances to create chemical solutions.
